title: Photograph an object
intro: Take a photo of an everyday object, or upload one from your device.
privacyPeople: Photograph the object, not people. Keep faces, documents, addresses and private rooms out of the picture; any face we spot is blurred on your device before it is uploaded.
privacyUse: We use your photo only to recognise the object for your lesson.
privacyStorage: It is stored privately on Cloudflare R2 and never shown to other learners. When photo recognition is on, it is sent to Meta's model API, or to OpenAI's if Meta is unavailable; neither may train on it.
privacyRetention: It is deleted within {days} days, or sooner once recognised, unless you choose to keep it.
facesBlurredOne: We blurred a face on your device, so no one can be recognised.
facesBlurredOther: We blurred {count} faces on your device, so no one can be recognised.
facesUnchecked: We couldn't check this photo for faces. If anyone is in it, choose another photo.
liveCameraUnsupported: This browser can't show a live camera here, so your camera app opens instead.
readFailed: We couldn't read that photo. Try another one.
cropFailed: We couldn't crop that photo. Try again, or use the whole photo.
cropStatus: We framed what looks like the object. Adjust it if you need to, then press Done.
readyWithIssues: Photo ready to upload, though it may be hard to recognise.
issuesLead: This photo may be hard to recognise.
issuesAdvice: Try another, or upload it anyway.
cameraUnavailableNote: {reason} You can use your camera app or upload a photo instead.
cameraNotAllowed: Camera access was not allowed, so we can't show a live view here.
cameraNotFound: We couldn't find a camera on this device.
cameraFailed: We couldn't start the camera here.
cameraReady: Camera ready. Frame the object, then snap.
cameraPrivacyHint: The live view stays on your device. Only the photo you snap is uploaded, and only when you choose Upload photo.
cropAreaWhole: Crop area, the whole photo. Arrow keys move it; Shift and arrow keys resize it.
cropAreaPart: Crop area, {width}% wide and {height}% tall. Arrow keys move it; Shift and arrow keys resize it.
keptBeforeLink: Photo kept. You can delete it any time from
keepExplain: Otherwise it is deleted about an hour after we recognise it. If you keep it, we store it privately until you delete it. It is never shown to anyone else and never used to train AI. Only this device can find it again, from your privacy choices.
notAPhoto: “{name}” is not a photo. Choose a {formats} file.
tooLarge: “{name}” is too large. Photos can be up to {size}.
tooSmall: The photo is too small to recognise the object. Retake it closer or use a larger photo.
blurry: The photo looks blurry or very plain. Hold the camera still and retake it.
tooDark: The photo is too dark. Move into better light and retake it.
tooBright: The photo is too bright. Avoid direct glare and retake it.
subjectSmall: The object looks small or missing. Move closer so it fills the frame.
checksUnavailable: Photo checks are unavailable in this browser.
formatUnreadable: This photo format cannot be read in your browser. Try JPG or PNG.
processingUnavailable: Photo processing is unavailable in this browser.
cropNotPositive: Choose a crop area with a positive width and height.
describeHint: Anything you can see or name, like a kettle, a rainbow or a bike bell.
questionHeading: What would you like to know about the {name}?
minQuestion: Write a question of at least {count} characters.
nothingSeen: We couldn't tell what this is. Tell us what it is, or try a photo of an everyday object, close up and in good light.
possibilities: We can see a few possibilities. Pick the one that matches.
somethingElse: Something else? Tell us what it is
